svg.title: Objective E2V and Subjective emotion confusion matrices
svg.desc: Paired row-normalized confusion matrices for six text-to-speech models. Objective E2V uses six target emotions and seven displayed output labels after merging disgusted, other, and unknown; Subjective uses six target and six listener-selected emotions.
svg.text: Rows: target emotion · Columns: predicted emotion · row-normalized proportions
Objective (E2V): Disgusted, Other, and Unknown are merged into Other; Subjective has six listener-selectable labels. Cell values are row proportions.
